_comment: Meetup scenes (schema: docs/SPEC_V2.md section 2). Optional "about" on arrive/leave scenes = ids of who arrives/leaves (default: the non-main participants, or everyone if all are mains).

lines: I can hear the cheese drawer from here.
There's a technique in here that sounds like a spa treatment. I'd like to book one.
No, I'm not going to 'spatchcock' you, so stop asking.
You haven't even heard my pitch.
Watch this. Couch to beanbag, one jump.
Nova bonks his forehead gently against Iggy's.
I needed somewhere to put my feet.
It's about to be the crate you sleep in.
No wires. It could be anywhere.
It's in the fridge again, isn't it.
I said snack-SIZED. I'm describing, not planning.
You're holding one like a cracker.
Impossible. I only have forty saves of the same game.
Backups. A pharmacist always keeps a backup.
Why are you lying on the floor?
You're a cat. You're tired. Get on the couch.
Iggy drops onto the couch. Nova lifts the blanket without looking.
You're already paying it. You're warm.
It's an apron. It's not a contract.
A quick kiss on the cheek. Iggy keeps stirring.
Pup, you've got flour on your nose.
You've got flour on your nose, Iggy.
The C-stick is a tiny yellow nub that believes in itself.
I took it as one. That's how compliments work.
Lunch. Grilled cheese and tomato soup.
You've asked for it every day this week.
And it's been perfect every day this week. Consistency is a virtue.
The GameCube has a handle. It's a lunchbox.
Then why does carrying it make me hungry?
I'm home. I counted four thousand tablets and I can't feel my paws.
You're the best thing that ever happened to this house.
The door opens. Nova sniffs the air.
Kidding. It's in the oven, keeping warm.
Did you get the good bread?
I'd carry you and the bags. But mostly the bread.
I'm back. Why is the couch upside down?
Iggy films the fort from every angle.
Off to the pharmacy. Somebody's got to count all those tiny things.
We have sensible snacks. I'm going out for snacks.
Heading to the shops. Don't touch the stove.
I'm resting my eyes. Very hard.
Iggy tucks the blanket round him on the way out.
New rotation. I'd like to formally thank the memory cards for their service.
Third check's the charm. Professional habit.
Card {card} is synced. I'm labelling it.
Now it's labelled with a star sticker.
The cards have been in rotation a while. Like leftovers.
Already? Time flies when you're napping.
Whenever, then. After lunch. After the nap after lunch.
Those are the glow stickers on the ceiling.
Iggy shuffles closer under the blanket.
You said that four races ago.
And I meant it every time.
The fridge light comes on at two in the morning.
I'm a fox with a kettle.
Why is my ear flat on one side?
Early shift. Where's my name badge?
{game}. I'm going to cry at the ending again.
You've been fishing for three hours.
The loan can wait. The fish can't.
{game}. I pick whoever has the biggest cape.
I pick whoever beats the cape.
At the others, Iggy. At the OTHERS.
He's on a cord and still tidier than you.
You'll be asleep in ten minutes.
That's the highest compliment I give a game.
You can't see the screen from there.
The walls are part of the track if you believe in yourself.
Have we survived you stealing my stars?
Hey, you two. I brought snacks.
Someone's tail is in my ear.
Player three's the golden controller. I'm golden. It's science.
There are three toothbrushes in the bathroom.
He's been here so long his toothbrush has seniority.
It's got tenure. I'm very proud of it.
Come look. The sky's doing the thing.
All three crowd at the window.
The door opens. A bag of crisps comes in first.
We did miss you a bit.
Hey, you two. I followed the sunset. It led here.
I'm home. Why are there three mugs out?
Back. Who moved the milk crate?
Golden hour. I'm off to catch it.
Bring back the mug you took last time.
Okay, heading home for a bit.
My toothbrush lives here now. I'm just visiting it.
Group hug by the door. It lasts a while.
Off to work. Don't have fun without me.
Going to the shops. Nobody touch the stove.
Can we touch each other's snacks?
New rotation. Three of us, three opinions.
Card {card} is ready! I watched the whole bar.
Rotation's due, right? I'm staying for the shuffle.
A pillow fort holds three. Barely.
Somebody's knee is in my back.
Morning! I counted. Nova's got four.
I count by fives. Four is just on the way to five.
Iggy and I are a team. Two per kart.
Then I'm racing you both. With bananas.
Iggy wins nine in a row without changing expression.
{game}. Three players. Rule one: no stealing stars.
Sunsets come with the stars included. It's a bundle.
I've only burnt one thing. It was toast. It was going to happen anyway.
Shops. You can have Iggy's side of the couch.
Duskie arrives holding two grilled cheese sandwiches.
I've never been happier to see anyone.
I know. That's why I brought two.
Hey. I let myself in. Made tea.
Heading off. Tell Iggy I said hi.
I'll tell Iggy you ate all the crisps.
Got to go. Sunset waits for no jackal.
Take a sandwich for the road.
I've got a shift. You'll be okay here?
I compounded this season myself. Bespoke.
You picked the ones with food in them.
You put a star sticker on it.
Cards look ready for a change.
Rotation's due. I'll wait for Iggy. Iggy has opinions.
Mine are louder. Iggy's are correct.
Probably. Want to surprise Iggy and do the dishes?
Morning. Did you sleep on the couch again?
The couch and I have an arrangement.
It's our couch now. It told me.
{game} at sunset is the best version.
Everything's the best version at sunset with you around.
I know. It's my whole brand.
I'll play. You hold the blanket.
I'll hold the blanket over my head.
Want to play something loud to make up for it?
I want one shot of me cooking. Nova never films me.
Rolling. You look great. Very chef.
It's a milk crate. A nicer one.
Then I'll keep you company. And the fridge.
Duskie knocks. Iggy opens the door before the second knock.
How'd you know it was me?
I'm back. Why's the kettle warm?
Hey. Made you tea. Figured you'd be home soon.
Off for a bit. Need anything?
Heading out. Tell Nova I said hi.
Take the leftovers. Please. Nova eats them in his sleep.
Saving him from himself. On it.
Anything. Call me if it does.
Nova's going to complain about one of them.
That's Nova's thing. I'm leaving it off out of respect.
Wait for Nova. He likes the ceremony.
There's a speech. It's short. It's not short.
Nova's on a late shift. House is weird without him.
Duskie sits beside Iggy, shoulder to shoulder.
He does chores. Nova should watch.
The house is quiet. Suspiciously quiet.
With nobody filming, nothing I do right now counts.
Nova eats a slice of cheese straight from the packet.
Iggy's out. The milk crate is unguarded.
Nova stands on it. Looks around. Gets down again.
It's not the same without someone telling me to get down.
Alone with the GameCube. Just two cubes, talking.
Note to self: count the snacks.
Second note to self: eat the snacks first. Fewer to count.
Midnight. House to myself. The kitchen is mine.
The camcorder on the shelf stares at him. Its light is off.
Morning. No tea made. That means I have to make tea.
Step one: kettle. I'll nap after step one.
Fine. More grilled cheese for me.
Off to work. Bye, GameCube. Bye, couch. Bye, sandwich I can't take with me.
He takes the sandwich with him.
New rotation, and nobody here to admire it.
I'll admire it for both of us. Lovely. Very well compounded.
Card {card} is ready. I checked it three times.
Nobody's watching, so I'll check it a fourth time. Purely recreational.
...Too nice. I'll go wake Nova up. Oh. He's out.
Iggy plays back old camcorder tapes.
Nova falling off the beanbag. Nova falling off the couch. Nova falling off the beanbag again.
Made enough for three anyway. Habit.
Nobody's asked for a snack in ten minutes.
I miss it. Don't tell anyone.
Iggy leaves the porch light on and the soup on low.
Good. Time to hide the good cheese.
Heading out. Lights off. Stove off. Camcorder on.
Nova's going to want a speech. I'll write him notes.
I'll wait. Nova likes doing it together.
Huh. Just me. House-sitting, I guess.
They left me in charge. Big mistake. Huge fun.
Duskie opens a bag of crisps. Then another.
Should I tidy up before they get back?
I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting. On the couch.
Left a note on the fridge, and a bag of crisps. The note says "for Nova". The crisps say "for Iggy".
Late, quiet, and I'm on the couch again.
The couch and I really are in a committed relationship.
Hello. I let myself in. The door is a rectangle. I respect that.
They are putting me in a pickle at work tomorrow.
Thank you. This is the best part of my week.
Yes. My face will not show it. But yes.
He's beaming. I can tell. Look at those facets.
I have a meeting about the meeting.
I cannot. It is mandatory. Like gravity.
It is ALWAYS a nice cape. Is there a horror game? I wish to be terrified.
I have come for the HUNT.
Vesper returns with the crisps, cape swirling.
Very stealthy. We heard every rustle.
Want to play the horror one?
More than ANYTHING. I will be behind the cushion for all of it.
I will HEAR it. That is terrifying enough.
Um. Hi. The door was open... sort of...
Did you just apologise to the chair?
Is there... a cozy game on...?
Oh... I'll just watch... for a bit... and then maybe...
Ten minutes later, Tuft is holding the controller and humming.
Hi! Inventory! How many free blocks have you got?
Fifty-nine blocks per card! I've counted yours twice!
Oh no. There are two of them.
Hello! Is it time for repotting?
The games need fresh soil! New cards! More light!
Are your games getting enough light?
Oh no. Oh no no. Open the drawer a little. Just a little.
Nova opens the drawer a crack. Sprout carefully waters the air above it.
Pardon me. Mind the doorframe. Mostly mine.
Stilts. Still not taller than me.
I'm a full head taller, Nova.
Stilts, can you reach the top shelf?
Pardon, but you did ask the tall one.
Flurry curls up by the radiator, tail tucked under her chin.
She's holding her tail. Pick something gentle.
